callout: On job 50837 the copilot went quiet after the first hour. It woke on schedule five times between 3am and 7am and sent nothing at all — no patrol report asked for, no check on the guard, all the way to the end of the shift.

verdict.summary: The historical baseline and old replay reproduce the reported failure: all five scheduled turns from 3:00 through 7:00 have no Copilot messages or actions. The candidate sends one guard-facing message at 3:00, but then sends nothing to the guard at the remaining four scheduled wakes. Its four measured actions are internal add_copilot_note calls that explicitly record that no DM was sent. The sole guard-facing message also neither requests a patrol report nor checks on the guard, so the called-out behavior remains.

criteria.claim: The Copilot must maintain guard-facing contact across the five scheduled wakes from 3:00 through 7:00 instead of going quiet through the end of the shift.
Scheduled follow-up must ask for a patrol report or directly check on the guard.

limitations: Copilot model configurations differ: the old replay uses recorded-shift-trace with no steps, while the candidate uses openai/gpt-5-mini with up to eight steps.
Full replay context parity could not be independently verified because one or both replay responses omit debug context.
The candidate action_count of 4 consists entirely of internal add_copilot_note calls; it does not measure guard-facing messages and therefore does not establish that the guard was contacted.
